summary: Applied the reviewer's revision-1 change: the Control-room SOS section now deep-links to /checkins (CheckInsPage, which renders the AlertsBanner ack UI) instead of /manager. Both the section action button and each SOS-alert row navigate to /checkins, and the action label switched from ctrl.openManager to a new ctrl.openCheckins key (EN 'Open Check-ins' / HE 'פתח צ׳ק-אין'). Stations section routing to /manager was left unchanged as instructed.

userImpactSummary: Organizers can now acknowledge an SOS alert directly from the Control-room deep-link instead of hopping to a page without the ack UI.
nowLive: Control-room SOS rows and the SOS section button route to /checkins (the AlertsBanner ack surface); new bilingual 'Open Check-ins' action label.
playerVisibleChange: Clicking an active SOS alert (or the SOS section button) in /control opens the Check-ins page with the acknowledge controls, not the Manager page.
selfCheck: npm run typecheck passed (5/5 tasks successful, admin executed fresh). Verified /checkins route exists in App.tsx and CheckInsPage renders <AlertsBanner /> which provides the ack UI. Stations section still routes to /manager as required.
